title: Metronome task
description: One unit of work in the pipeline. A task is created by qualification, carried by the implementer, judged by the reviewer, and closed by merge and deploy. This is the shape state.lua stores and the panel renders.

title.description: One line a human can scan in the panel.

intent.description: The task's own intention, as detailed by the qualifier. This is the work item, not the user's ask.

failure_reason.description: Why the task last failed, persisted from the transition that moved it to failed. Absent when the task never failed.

failure.description: The last typed failure: what broke, what a human can do about it, and where the bounded retry stands. Written by state.transition(..., "failed", { failure = ... }) alongside failure_reason, and kept across a resume — a retry reads it to decide whether to start again and from which checkpoint.

cause.description: The closed-set cause from recover.CAUSES (git_identity, network, timeout, quota, ...). This is what the retry policy keys on.

message.description: What actually happened, on one line, as the failing tool printed it.

remedy.description: The actionable fix for a human, or the command to run, when the retry cannot do it alone.

transient.description: Whether the same attempt can succeed again without a human. A transient failure is retried under a bounded backoff; anything else escalates.

attempts.description: How many times this failure was recorded. A resume resets it to 0, because the budget is for consecutive attempts, not for the task's whole life.

at.description: When the failure was recorded: ISO 8601 UTC, or epoch seconds as recover.record produces it. The cause survives a resume; this timestamp does.

next_retry_at.description: When the bounded retry may run again, same representation as `at`. Absent once the task resumed: nothing is scheduled any more.

phase.description: The pipeline stage that was running when it broke, so the resume restarts there instead of from the top.

quarantine.description: Why the analyzer blocks this task, when it does. A puzzling task is set aside instead of stopping the pipeline: it keeps its status and carries this object until a clean re-analysis clears it with a quarantine_cleared event. Absent means the task is not quarantined.

reason.description: The named reason the panel shows, so a freeze is never silent.

rules.description: The analyzer rules that blocked the task, in report order.

findings.description: The blocking findings themselves, as the analyst reported them, so the quarantine is actionable without re-running the analysis.

since.description: When the task was quarantined: ISO 8601 UTC, or epoch seconds as the runtime records it.

origin.description: The intention the user submitted, kept verbatim. Every task a submission produced carries the same origin, which is what the panel groups requests by. Absent on tasks created before this field existed; readers fall back to `intent`.

status.description: Where the task sits in the state machine. state.lua owns the legal transitions.

phase.description: The pipeline stage currently running, for the panel.

branch.description: Git branch the task works on.

worktree.description: Absolute path of the isolated git worktree for this task.

base_ref.description: Branch the task was cut from. A subtask of a multi-task intention is cut from the epic branch, not the project base.

kind.description: An epic task owns the single PR from the epic branch to the project base. Absent means an ordinary task.

files.description: Files the task expects to touch. The scheduler refuses to run two tasks in parallel whose file sets overlap.

checks.description: Commands that prove the task is done. A task is not done because the model says so; it is done when these exit 0.

acceptance.description: The observable outcomes that prove the task is done, kept from qualification so the sheet can be re-rendered from the task record alone.

pr.description: The pull request, once one exists.

review.description: The review loop state. commit_sha is the exact commit reviewed, so a branch that moves invalidates the review.

questions.description: Questions the qualifier raised. Metronome poses them to the user, at most max_questions_per_round at a time.

depends_on.description: Tasks that must reach merged before this one starts.

checkpoints.description: Commit SHAs captured before each implementation turn, so a retry restarts from a clean point instead of from nothing.

notes.description: Free-form notes appended by the pipeline, kept in order.

cost.description: Dollars billed for this task so far.

conflict_retried.description: A conflict with the base was repaired once by redoing the task on the fresh base.

conflict_retries.description: How many times the task was redone on a fresh base after a conflict.
